svg.title: How aliarbab2009.com is put together
svg.desc: Content: Typed config (Projects, lab designs, timeline and resume as TypeScript.) Then: Rendering: Next.js App Router (Server components, with a theme per project through CSS custom properties.) Then: Checks: CI gates (Typecheck, lint, format, tests and build.); Privacy audit (Searches the built site for anything that must not be published.) Then: Delivery: Vercel (Deploys main. Strict content security policy with per-request nonces.)
